answer: A random-beacon spot check with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts 500 POA; each epoch a beacon names a 5% sample, and each must solve a puzzle in 60 seconds — a raven answers in its own voice. One honest agent tends one orchard, passes, and keeps deposit and full share. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines at 500 POA a month each — 500,000 POA for less — a missed check burns it, so the river flows only to the living.
